tagline: Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world
hero_kpi_rationale: The strategic partnership with NVIDIA and the integration of Infinera position Nokia at the heart of the AI wave for mobile and optical networks, a key segment for future growth.

kpis.name: AI and cloud segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to network infrastructure for AI and cloud, including optical networks and RAN.
kpis.description: Nokia powers the data centers of major cloud providers with its advanced optical solutions.
kpis.signal: 9 out of 10 global hyperscalers use Nokia's optical networks

kpis.name: Net bookings
kpis.explanation: New orders signed in advanced networks, particularly for AI and 5G.
kpis.description: Sustained R&D investment to capture demand for advanced connectivity. Net sales 2025: EUR 19,889 million.
kpis.signal: Approximately EUR 160 billion invested in R&D since 2000 in critical technologies

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin across all businesses.
kpis.description: Improvement in product mix quality and operational efficiencies.
kpis.signal: Margin improving due to higher-end network product mix

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Cost discipline and operational transformation are delivering results.
kpis.signal: Operating margin improving despite investments in AI

kpis.name: R&D investments as percentage of revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Nokia maintains intense R&D efforts to remain at the forefront of 5G/6G and optical networks.
kpis.signal: High R&D investment rate, typical of technology leaders

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets to maintain and expand capacity.
kpis.description: Investments focused on R&D campuses and industrialization of new technologies.
kpis.signal: Moderate but targeted capex on key innovations (AI, optics)

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.description: Headcount stabilized around 78,000 following Infinera integration and regional adjustments (North America 10K, Europe 33K, Greater China 7.2K, India 18.3K, Asia Pacific 3.9K, LATAM 2.8K, MEA 2.8K).
kpis.signal: Slight workforce reduction in the context of rationalization

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.description: Free Cash Flow (M EUR). Metric tracked annually by company analysts, historical data over the last 5 years.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Net income of EUR 0.66 billion in the latest fiscal year.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of EUR 0.07 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of EUR 0.759 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years using yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 116.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: Rapid adoption of AI in enterprise and hyperscaler network customers.
kpis.signal: 65 percent of new cloud deals include AI components

kpis.name: Cloud backlog
kpis.explanation: Amount of future commitments for cloud services and associated networks.
kpis.description: The partnership with NVIDIA and the closing of Infinera have strengthened the cloud order backlog. AI & Cloud bookings: EUR 2.4 billion.
kpis.signal: Cloud backlog growing strongly, supported by strategic partnerships

risks.title: Macroeconomic and tariff uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned at the beginning of the Board review section (high position), moderate language ('persisted', 'highlights the importance'), stable/persistent trend in 2025, indirect impact on supply chain.

risks.title: Dependence on AI technological innovation
risks.score_rationale: Central risk in strategy (mentioned 8+ times), strong language ('crucial', 'long-term structural shift'), increasing trend (new AI-native positioning), high weight as technology is core business.

risks.title: Infinera acquisition integration risks
risks.score_rationale: Major acquisition (EUR 1.3B in sales in 2025), mentioned in operational results (middle of report), neutral language but visible impact (acquisition costs, contractual provisions), new trend (February 2025).

risks.title: Decline in profitability and gross margin
risks.score_rationale: Clear financial data (middle of report): gross margin down from 46.1% to 43.5%, operating profit down 55% (from EUR 1970M to EUR 885M), factual language but alarming figures, increasing trend (YoY deterioration).

risks.title: Geopolitical exposure and sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the opening ('Significant geopolitical...challenges'), strong language ('persisted'), impact on Greater China (-19% sales), increasing trend (2025 tense context), high weight for telecom equipment provider.

risks.title: Hyperscaler customer concentration risk
risks.score_rationale: Implied in strategy (Infinera for 'hyperscalers', AI & Cloud clients), mid-report position, moderate language but clear structural dependence, increasing trend (new strategic focus).

risks.title: Cash flow and R&D investments
risks.score_rationale: Financial data (end of report): free cash flow down 27% (from EUR 2021M to EUR 1465M), R&D up to 24.4% of sales, factual language, increasing trend (growing investments vs declining cash).

risks.title: Organizational transition and leadership
risks.score_rationale: CEO change (Hotard April 2025) and Chair departure (Baldauf 2026), high position (Board review), neutral language but multiple transitions, new trend (2025-2026), moderate weight (planned succession).

ai_positioning.summary: Nokia is adopting an AI integration strategy into its existing networks, partnering with NVIDIA to develop AI-native mobile networks. The company positions itself as an enabler of AI for operators and hyperscalers.
evidence: Strategic partnership with NVIDIA (USD 1 billion investment)
9 out of 10 top hyperscalers use Nokia's optical networks
